'''Bail Antilles''' was an alias that was used by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Alias-stub}}

==Biography==
This individual worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and used the alias "Bail Antilles" while posing as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], during a mission to extract the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Malkor Trel]] from the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].
